The bounded C muxer in ../../mux.c adapts these MIT-licensed files from the
already downloaded official AlexxIT/go2rtc 1.9.14 source tree:
https://github.com/AlexxIT/go2rtc/tree/v1.9.14/pkg/iso
https://github.com/AlexxIT/go2rtc/blob/v1.9.14/pkg/pcm/flac.go

Original input SHA-256:

Only H.264 AVC and mono 8kHz FLAC/verbatim remain. The implementation uses
fixed-size MP4 metadata, one bounded frame and one browser client. It does
not embed or execute any Go code. Preserve this license in firmware builds.
